name: Joey
dialogue_before: I like shorts! They're comfy and easy to wear!
dialogue_after: I lost, but my Rattata is in the top percentage!

name: Rick
dialogue_before: Yo! You can't pass without battling me!
dialogue_after: Ugh, my bugs weren't strong enough...

name: Sally
dialogue_before: Let's have a Pokemon battle!
dialogue_after: Oh no, I lost! You're pretty good.

name: Liam
dialogue_before: You dare challenge Brock? You'll have to get through me first!
dialogue_after: Go ahead, but Brock is way tougher than me.

name: Ben
dialogue_before: Hey! I saw you looking over here!
dialogue_after: Wow, you're tougher than you look!

name: Crissy
dialogue_before: Tee hee! Let's battle with our cute Pokemon!

name: Timmy
dialogue_before: I just caught an Ekans! Wanna see how strong it is?

name: Marcos
dialogue_before: These mountains are my home! You won't pass easily!
dialogue_after: You've got some strong Pokemon there...

name: Kent
dialogue_before: I found these Paras deep in the cave!

name: Jovan
dialogue_before: I've been studying the fossils here. Care for a battle?
dialogue_after: Back to my research, I suppose...

name: Diana
dialogue_before: You'll need to beat me before you can challenge Misty!
dialogue_after: Go ahead... Misty is way tougher than me though!

name: Luis
dialogue_before: The Cerulean Gym is a water paradise!

name: Lenny
dialogue_before: I've been hiking this route for years!
dialogue_after: You're stronger than the mountain Pokemon!

name: Rocket Grunt
dialogue_before: Hey kid, you've got some skill! How about joining Team Rocket? ...No?! Then I'll make you regret it!
dialogue_after: Grr... You'll regret crossing Team Rocket! We'll remember this!

name: Rocket Grunt
dialogue_before: You saw nothing, kid! Get out of here or you'll regret it!
dialogue_after: Tch! You'll pay for this! Team Rocket never forgets!

name: Ethan
dialogue_before: Welcome to Nugget Bridge! Defeat all five trainers to win a prize!
dialogue_after: Good luck with the next trainer!

name: Ali
dialogue_before: You beat the first one? Let's see how you handle me!

name: Calvin
dialogue_before: Three down, two to go! But I won't make it easy!

name: Shannon
dialogue_before: You're almost there! But can you beat me?
dialogue_after: One more trainer to go! Keep it up!

name: Josh
dialogue_before: I'm the last trainer on the bridge! Give it your all!
dialogue_after: Incredible! You've cleared the Nugget Bridge Challenge!

name: Wayne
dialogue_before: The path to Bill's house is treacherous!
dialogue_after: You're tough! Bill's house is just ahead.

name: Haley
dialogue_before: Are you going to visit Bill? Me too!

name: Keigo
dialogue_before: I'm training my bugs for the Vermilion Gym!
dialogue_after: I need to catch stronger bugs...

name: Dave
dialogue_before: Vermilion City is just past here! But first, battle me!
dialogue_after: You're heading to Vermilion too? Good luck!

name: Eddie
dialogue_before: Route 11 is my turf! Let's battle!

name: Rich
dialogue_before: I'll bet it all on this battle! Let's go!
dialogue_after: Looks like I lost my bet...

name: Perry
dialogue_before: I've been catching bugs along this route!

name: Arthur
dialogue_before: A battle aboard the S.S. Anne? How delightful!

name: Ann
dialogue_before: Isn't this cruise wonderful? Let's battle to celebrate!
dialogue_after: Oh my! You're quite the trainer!

name: Tyler
dialogue_before: My dad brought me on this cruise! Wanna battle?

name: Huey
dialogue_before: I've been working out on this ship! Let me show you my muscles!
dialogue_after: Your Pokemon pack more of a punch than mine!

name: Duncan
dialogue_before: You look like a landlubber! I'll teach you how to battle at sea!
dialogue_after: Blimey! You fight like a seasoned sailor!

name: Patricia
dialogue_before: The spirits... they speak to me...

name: Carly
dialogue_before: Ke ke ke ke! You dare enter this tower?

name: Hope
dialogue_before: Be gone! The spirits command it!

name: Laurel
dialogue_before: This tower is sacred ground! Leave at once!
dialogue_after: Perhaps the spirits have chosen you...

name: Jody
dialogue_before: I can feel the restless spirits all around us...

name: Rocket Grunt
dialogue_before: Get out of our way! Team Rocket has business here!
dialogue_after: You'll pay for interfering with Team Rocket!

name: Rocket Grunt
dialogue_before: We won't let you interfere!
dialogue_after: Grr... You haven't seen the last of Team Rocket!

name: Megan
dialogue_before: My Pokemon are so cute! But they're tough too!

name: Glenn
dialogue_before: I've been studying the electromagnetic fields on this route!
dialogue_after: My research was no match for your battling...

name: Stan
dialogue_before: I'm betting it all on this battle!
dialogue_after: Looks like I gambled and lost...

name: Barny
dialogue_before: I've been fishing here all day! Let's battle!

name: Dan
dialogue_before: Route 12 is the best place to train!

name: Lisa
dialogue_before: Our Gym Leader Erika is a master of Grass-type Pokemon!
dialogue_after: You're strong, but Erika is even stronger!

name: Bridget
dialogue_before: The fragrance of Grass-type Pokemon is so lovely!

name: Tamia
dialogue_before: Grass Pokemon are full of vitality!
dialogue_after: Even the sun couldn't save my Pokemon...

name: Lao
dialogue_before: This is our turf! No one passes without a battle!
dialogue_after: You beat me... but the others won't be so easy!

name: Carter
dialogue_before: My birds are the fastest around!

name: Virgil
dialogue_before: Cycling Road belongs to us bikers!

name: Billy
dialogue_before: You think you can ride with the big boys?

name: Nikolas

dialogue_after: No way... I lost to a kid!

name: Lass Lisa
dialogue_before: Our Gym Leader Erika is so elegant!
dialogue_after: You're strong... Erika will be tougher though!

name: Beauty Bridget
dialogue_before: Grass Pokemon are so beautiful!

name: Lass Kay
dialogue_before: Do you know about Grass-type Pokemon?
dialogue_after: I lost... but I learned something!

name: Biker Lao
dialogue_before: You think you can take the Cycling Road? Ha!

name: Bird Keeper Boris
dialogue_before: My birds rule the skies of Route 16!

name: Biker Ruben
dialogue_before: Cycling Road belongs to us bikers!

name: Biker Billy
dialogue_before: Three on one? That's how we roll!
dialogue_after: No way... all three of them!

name: Biker Jaxon
dialogue_before: You made it this far? Not bad!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Hey! How'd you get down here?!
dialogue_after: I'll report you to the boss!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Team Rocket will take over the world!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: You can't stop our plans!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Get out of our hideout!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Nobody gets past this floor!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: For Team Rocket!
dialogue_after: The boss will deal with you!

dialogue_before: I foresaw your arrival!

name: Psychic Tyron
dialogue_before: The mind is the greatest weapon!

name: Channeler Patricia
dialogue_before: The spirits guide my hands...

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Silph Co. belongs to Team Rocket!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: You're not authorized to be here!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: For Team Rocket's glory!

name: Grunt
dialogue_before: Team Rocket rules!
dialogue_after: This isn't the last you'll see of us!

dialogue_before: The art of fighting is all about discipline!

dialogue_before: I train every day!

dialogue_before: Poison types are tricky!
